name: Model Disagreement Sample
description: Selects experimental conditions where multiple models disagree the most in their predictions, useful for model comparison and ensemble learning.

parameters.name: conditions
parameters.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions to evaluate for model disagreement.

parameters.name: models
parameters.description: List of scikit-learn compatible models (regression or classification) to compare.

parameters.name: num_samples
parameters.description: Number of high-disagreement samples to select.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: DataFrame or array of candidate experimental conditions.

inputDataType.name: models
inputDataType.description: List of fitted models for prediction comparison.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: DataFrame of selected high-disagreement experimental conditions.
